vcu_g_0159_20001feb.name: exint_pa1_boot_level
vcu_g_0159_20001feb.description: Boot-time level of PA1 (GPIOA pin 1), stored as 0 or 1. It is written once by vcu_exint14_pb14_init from the result of the function at 0x08007A9C, which returns 1 when PA1 reads high and 0 otherwise. Probably a hardware variant strap read at power-up (the packet shows no other source). Readers: vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval and vcu_panel_key_report_telemetry_tick. When it is 1 they scale the three sensor words by 1/15 instead of 1/14, and vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval uses an upper limit of 220 instead of 215. No other writer appears in this packet, so the value holds from boot until the next reset.
